decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 11:00 - 23:00 Monday - Sunday.

Condition : 3 - The use shall not commence until the extract ducting is implemented in accordance with the application details.  The extract ducting shall be retained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted Current, 26/6/12 (received 12/11/2012) section, side elevation section (received 10/12/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Change of use of the property from existing hairdressers (A1 retail use)  to proposed Indian restaurant (A3 use restaurant/cafe)
